params.message:
One classifier prompt, sent by production and judged by the evals

classify.mjs, the model experiment and benchmark in self-improve.mjs and the gold-set
eval in eval-models.mjs each wrote their own copy of the classifier prompt, and the two
eval copies had drifted (no geography tiers, no Asian-platform exception, a shorter
rubric). A model that won an eval had won on a prompt production never sends. The
prompt is now classify-prompt.mjs; production's text is byte-identical, so the prompt
hash in the classify log does not move. The evals label samples by position and match
on index or id.
